newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks in London, banks hold firm.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks in London, banks hold firm.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks eased in London after stronger-than-expected U.S. economic data dragged U.S. bonds and UK stocks lower, London traders said.
The Hang Seng London Reference Index were off 6.22 points at 11,321.99 at 1313 GMT.
In Hong Kong, the Hang Seng index closed 51.28 points lower at 11,328.21.
Hong Kong banks, up about HK$1 across the board at the open, halved initial gains as the broad market slipped, traders said.
"Banks have been resilient and I expect that will continue to be the case," a trader said.
